note: Stage 2 final challenge. English only. Scene one recaps ten-and-ones, adding and taking away, then asks a question and answers it after one second. Scene two shows the stage trophy. Answer phase mixes three types (listen and tap / drag the blocks / find the wrong sentence) with no self-answer. Gold run plays a graduation line after the gold line.

lines.text: You have learned so much! Tens and ones, adding, and taking away.
Are you ready for the final challenge of this stage?
This is the stage two trophy.
Get all ten right, and it is yours!
Fifteen plus three. Tap the right answer.
Twelve plus four. Tap the right answer.
Seventeen minus five. Tap the right answer.
Eleven plus six. Tap the right answer.
Match the blocks to the right number.
Stage two champion! Here is your trophy!
